testimonial_daniela: La Beca Universitaria de la Fundación ALZA representa una gran oportunidad para hacer realidad mis sueños. Gracias a este apoyo, podría continuar mis estudios sin que las limitaciones económicas sean un obstáculo. Esta beca me permitiría concentrarme plenamente en mi formación, adquirir materiales de estudio y participar en actividades que fortalezcan mis habilidades como futura licenciada en educación. También me motivaría a seguir esforzándome para alcanzar la excelencia y devolver, con mi trabajo y dedicación, la confianza que la Fundación deposita en jóvenes como yo.
testimonial_itamar: Gracias a la beca que recibí, pude acceder a clases de inglés que me han abierto puertas increíbles, tanto en mi carrera académica como en mi vida personal. La universidad ha sido un desafío, pero también una experiencia increíble que me ha permitido crecer como persona y profesional. He podido desarrollar habilidades valiosas, ampliar mi red de contactos y descubrir nuevas pasiones. Estoy agradecido por esta oportunidad y espero que más estudiantes puedan beneficiarse de este programa y alcanzar sus objetivos.
header_mission: ALZA Foundation provides scholarships for language learning and university education to students from underserved communities, in Colombia.
Home_action-description_1: At ALZA Foundation, we support high-potential students from underserved communities in Colombia who face financial barriers to accessing higher education by providing targeted scholarship programs.
home_action-description-2: By investing in education, leadership, and personal growth, we help students build the skills and confidence needed to create lasting impact in their lives and communities.

about_mission: ALZA Foundation, Inc. is a U.S.-registered nonprofit organization dedicated to expanding access to language learning and higher education for high-potential students in Colombia.
about-us-mission-text: To expand access to language education and higher education for high-potential students in Colombia.
about-us-vision-text: A future in which talented students can pursue education regardless of socioeconomic barriers.
about-us-values-text: From board members to volunteers and students alike, we uphold the following values in every action, decision, and interaction with our communities and donors.
about-us-values-integrity-text: Acting honestly and ethically in all circumstances.
about-us-values-respect-text: Valuing diverse perspectives and treating everyone with dignity.
about-us-values-accountability-text: Taking responsibility for actions and decisions.
about-us-values-excellence-text: Striving for quality and diligence in all work.
about-us-values-students-text: Prioritizing the needs of our beneficiaries and their communities.
about-us-origin-2016: In Cartagena, Colombia, our founder began teaching basic English in Tierra Bomba and La Boquilla. With volunteer support, the initiative grew to serve over 30 students and open new opportunities through language.
about-us-origin-2019: After returning to the U.S., our founder continued supporting students by funding their English education. As students reached university age, he stepped in to fully cover the cost of higher education.
about-us-origin-2025: To ensure no student is held back by financial barriers, ALZA Foundation, Inc. was founded and the board of directors was established.
about-us-statement: ALZA exists because talent is everywhere, but opportunity is not.
about-us-team-text: ALZA Foundation is governed by a volunteer Board of Directors and operated with program and administrative support from volunteers and partners.

community_tierra_bomba_text: Tierra Bomba is a close-knit island community near Cartagena, Colombia, rooted in fishing and cultural traditions. Ongoing local efforts focus on expanding opportunities for young people.
community_boquilla_text: La Boquilla is an Afro-Caribbean coastal community north of Cartagena, known for its fishing heritage and cultural traditions. Local initiatives in sustainable tourism help strengthen economic opportunities for residents.
community_aranjuez_text: Villas de Aranjuez is a working-class neighborhood in Cartagena’s Barrios Unidos area. Recent improvements in infrastructure and community services support ongoing efforts to expand access to health, education, and social support.
community_olaya_text: Olaya Herrera is a large neighborhood in southeast Cartagena known for its community cohesion and cultural vibrancy. The area faces challenges such as limited resources, and high violence.
program_mission: ALZA Foundation supports students by removing financial barriers to education through targeted scholarship programs. Our programs focus on language preparation and university access for high-potential students from underserved communities in Colombia.
program_approach_text: ALZA Foundation focuses on long-term educational access rather than one-time assistance. By supporting students at critical points in their educational journey, our programs aim to reduce structural barriers and expand opportunities for academic success.

impact_testimonial_itamar: Itamar was one of the first students to take part of the ALZA Foundation’s Scholarship programs. Her educational motivation led her to be accepted to the University Rafael Nunez where she is currently enrolled in a Law program with a focus on Criminal Law and Criminology. With support through the program, she strengthened her English language skills and became a summer English teacher in her community, Tierra Bomba. From Itamar: "La universidad ha sido un desafío, pero también una experiencia increíble que me ha permitido crecer como persona y profesional.
impact_itamar_path: Law - Specialization in Criminal Law and Criminology
impact_testimonial_jose: José is a highly studious and driven student supported by the ALZA Foundation. With remarkable discipline and determination, he taught himself English and achieved fluency in less than two years. His ambition, initiative, and commitment to self-improvement reflect the kind of perseverance that inspires those around him and positions him for continued success. From Jose: Este apoyo no es solo financiero, también me da esperanza y me recuerda que hay personas que creen en estudiantes como yo y eso significa más de lo que puedo explicar.
impact_testimonial_yurleidis: Yurleidis is one of the dedicated students supported by the ALZA Foundation. She was among the most studious students our founder had the privilege to teach, consistently demonstrating strong motivation, focus, and determination. Through her hard work and perseverance, she is successfully completing her university studies in Nursing to get prepared to serve as a pillar of strength and care within her community. From Yurleidis: Este apoyo no solo representa una contribución económica, sino también un voto de confianza en mi potencial y en mis sueños.

faq_answer1: Yes — ALZA Foundation is a public charity organization exempt under IRC Section 501(c)(3). Donors can deduct contributions they make to the foundation under IRC Section 170.
faq_answer2: Yes — All donations made after our incorporation date (November 10th, 2025) are tax-deductible. Donors receive an emailed receipt for every contribution, which they can use when filing U.S. taxes.
faq_question3: How will my donation be used?
faq_answer3-1: Donations directly support our education and community programs, including: student scholarships, English-language education, mentorship and career readiness.
faq_answer3-2: Financial transparency is a priority, and we publish updates on how funds are allocated through our Newsletter.
faq_answer3-3: ALZA Foundation is committed to maintain their annual administrative costs below 10%.
faq_question4: Do you accept grant and partnership inquiries?
faq_answer4: Yes. We welcome inquiries from foundations and institutional partners aligned with our mission. For grant-related or partnership inquiries, please contact us directly at
